title: Moto Phase 7 — shot plan (moto-shots-v2)
description: One answer of Phase 7 for a custom motorcycle film: the shots chosen from every approved scene, as data, within the shot budget of the film, and the events and work of the source the film leaves between its shots. Every shot is one continuous take of exactly 3000 ms, all of it used, made from reference images: it owns its first frame, its action timeline, its camera path and its end frame. Film timing, environment sources, reference images, absent parts, limits and readiness are derived by code.

flags.description: Short notes for the reviewer. With status partial, name briefly what blocks, without copying whole conflicts. With status fail, name the fault in the input.

operating.description: The state of the motorcycle and what holds it at the first or the last instant of the shot, as the events it covers give it. Every key is present: null for what does not apply, [] for none.

support_refs.description: By id only: a part of the design, a character of the shot, or a temporary item the scene's build state lists.

action_step.description: One step of what happens in the shot. The steps run in order, the first from 0 ms, each from where the one before ends, the last to 3000 ms. What other people do at the same time is written in the same step.

event_ids.description: The events of the covered beats this step plays; [] for a step that only holds, opens or settles the picture.

path_segment.description: One stretch of the camera's single unbroken move. The segments run in order, the first from 0 ms, each from where the one before ends, the last to 3000 ms; the camera is moving in every one.

description.description: Where the camera travels in this stretch: from where to where, how fast, at what height, past what.

shot_card.description: A text card of the script on screen during the shot, with its time inside the shot.

evidence.description: Evidence paths resolve against this Phase 7 input; do not copy another phase's internal evidence paths unchanged or rewrite them by adding a prefix. path: dot-separated keys starting at a top-level key of this input; a list item is named by its id, by its beat or by its zero-based index, e.g. beats.B4.visual, scenes.SC03.continuity_start.placement, design_states.BS07.in_progress. quote: text copied verbatim from a text field or an item of a text list. value: the exact value and type of an id, an enumerated value, a number, a boolean, null or structured data; ids and enumerated values are never quoted.

coverage.description: A beat the shot shows and the events of that beat it plays, in the beat's order. A beat may run over several consecutive shots, each playing some of its events. An event no shot plays is listed in data.omissions; an event is never both played and omitted.

shown_part.description: A part in frame and how it is shown at the first frame. For a part a work item of the shot moves or keeps in place, the presentation it has at the start of the first such item (scenes[].work[].presentations); for any other part the work holds, the presentation the work shown so far left it in, carried through every later beat of the same build state; otherwise what the build state has: installed on the motorcycle, being_made in progress, awaiting_install or removed as the state lists it. drawing or model before a physical motorcycle exists. The presentation describes how the part is shown, never where it is: a part being_made may be on the motorcycle while it is tried on; where it is comes from the work (location_start, location_end).

framing.description: The most of the person the shot shows at any instant.

face_visibility.description: visible: the face can be seen and must be this character's. occluded: hidden by what the work makes them wear, such as a welding mask or a full helmet. out_of_frame: the crop never reaches the face.

off_frame_part.description: A part a covered beat names in design_refs but keeps out of frame. effect: what the part does to the picture, such as the light it throws into the frame.

camera.description: target, scale, height, distance, azimuth and elevation give the camera at 0 ms; path gives where it goes from there.

reference_need.description: What the clip needs a reference image of to stay faithful. identity: the motorcycle as a whole, target null. design: a part of the shot, target its id. environment: the shot's background, target its id, or null for a requested background. continuity: an earlier shot of the same continuous action — the same scene, or the scene the scene plan continues from — target its id. The people of the shot need no entry: code finds each character's approved reference from people.

work.description: The ids of the work items of the scene plan (scenes[].work[].id) the shot shows happening, in the scene plan's order within the shot and from shot to shot, never returning to an earlier item; each in a covered beat, with its part in parts. A work item no shot shows is listed in data.omissions. The shot never decides a removal, fitting or making of its own.

reveal.description: How much of the motorcycle the shot shows, on the scale of the script's reveal. A shot that covers several beats uses a reveal allowed by every covered beat. Shape and detail do not substitute for each other.

configurations.description: Positions of parts in frame only: every configuration listed belongs to a part in parts. For each part shown as installed whose position is established by the covered beats or a build-state exception, provide one configuration in both start and end. Start is the first frame; end is after the action. Never the whole list of operating_start or operating_end: a part that is not in parts has its position in the operating states only. [] when no part in frame has a position.

first_frame.description: What the picture shows at 0 ms, as a description: no keyframe image is needed. It shows operating_start and never the result the shot creates.

result.description: What must be readable in the picture when the shot ends.

end_frame.description: What the picture shows at 3000 ms. It shows operating_end.

continuity.description: changes: what changes during the shot. carries: the state the next shot starts from.

conflict.description: Names at least one shot or beat it affects.

omissions.description: Everything of the source the film does not show: every event no shot plays and every work item no shot shows is listed here exactly once, so nothing of the source is lost. [] only when the shots play every event and show every work item.

omission.description: Events and work of one scene that happen between two shots, outside the picture. They are over before 0 ms of before_shot; with before_shot null they happen after the last shot of the scene. Only ids of the source: an omission never adds an event or a work item.

before_shot.description: The shot of this scene the omitted events and work come before; null when they follow its last shot.

event_ids.description: Events of the scene's beats no shot plays, in the script's order.

work_ids.description: Work items of the scene plan (scenes[].work[].id) no shot shows, done outside the picture, in the scene plan's order.

reason.description: The editorial reason, in a few words.

evidence.description: The source records of what is omitted.
